message.content: {"research_brief": "How, if at all, do the Ronin Bridge theft and Harmony Horizon theft relate to one another through publicly documented attribution to Lazarus Group and/or APT38, common or comparable cryptocurrency-laundering patterns, and associated wallet or transaction evidence, based exclusively on evidence returned by the benchmark tools as of October 1, 2026? I want a complete, evidence-bounded report that distinguishes confirmed facts from allegations, analytical assessments, and uncertainty; identifies the relevant actors, entities, wallets, transactions, dates, attribution statements, laundering techniques, and relationships only when supported by tool-returned evidence; avoids inventing or inferring unsupported facts; cites only source IDs returned by the tools; and reports contradictions, gaps, and unresolved attribution questions. The report should use readable Markdown and include a fenced JSON object with exactly the arrays `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, where each finding contains `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`; each claim contains `claim` and `source_references`; each reasoning step contains `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`; and each contradiction contains `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`. No particular source type beyond the benchmark tools is required; prioritize primary or authoritative public attribution and blockchain evidence when returned, and treat all other source preferences as open-ended."}
